picks.name: ReUse Open House
picks.description: The ReBuilding Center's "Keep it in Motion" open house is a free afternoon of live music, food trucks, hands-on activities, and the debut of its new Reuse Showrooms. Don't miss the Salvage Showdown, where local artists transform reclaimed materials into one-of-a-kind art.

picks.name: Harvest Dinner at Edgefield
picks.description: A cozy fall harvest dinner at McMenamins' historic Edgefield — seasonal dishes and good company as the leaves turn. Get tickets early for this one!

picks.name: Roux
picks.description: Every October, Roux celebrates food, drink, and culture while elevating women-owned businesses — pop-up dinners, chef collabs, panels, and brunch across the city. Explore the full lineup at rouxportland.com.

picks.name: How to Cook a Steak
picks.description: Jacobsen Salt Co. teams up with Snake River Farms for a hands-on class on cooking the perfect steak — technique, seasoning, and plenty of tasting along the way. Walk away a better cook, and very well-fed.

picks.name: House of Horrors
picks.description: A house basement party with a slight Halloween lean — the kind of underground show that keeps Portland weird and alive. Expect high energy and to meet some new folks.

picks.name: Vivaldi's Four Seasons
picks.description: Vivaldi's Four Seasons performed by candlelight in the gorgeous Old Church — a live string ensemble, flickering light, and one of classical music's most beloved works. Pure autumn magic.

picks.name: Masquerade Boat Party
picks.description: A masquerade silent disco aboard the Portland Spirit — three DJ channels on your headphones, masks on, cruising the Willamette after dark. A one-of-a-kind night on the water. 21+.

picks.name: Weird Fiction Night
picks.description: A night of weird, eerie, and uncanny fiction read aloud at Brujos — part reading series, part Halloween mood. Free, strange, and perfectly October.
